purpose: A well-defined but empty campaign ledger. Rows are added only when a figure arrives from an authorised first-party report supplied by the account holder.
why_empty: No authorised first-party report has been provided to this build. Amazon click and order data lives behind Associates Central sign-in. Nothing is estimated, modelled or inferred, so the ledger starts at zero rows and says so.

columns.label: Timestamp (UTC)
columns.note: Moment the report row was exported, not the moment of the click.

columns.label: Source
columns.note: Every allowed value names a first-party report.

columns.label: Channel
columns.note: Free text describing the traffic channel, e.g. organic-search, rss, direct.

columns.label: Eligible sessions
columns.note: Leave null when the report does not supply it.

columns.label: Clicks
columns.note: Reported clicks only. Our own outbound_click counter is not a substitute and is never summed into this column.

columns.label: Reported orders
columns.note: Orders as reported by Amazon. Never derived from clicks.

columns.label: Provenance note
columns.note: Who exported the report, from which console, and where the original file is stored.

prohibitions: No conversion score is calculated or displayed from this ledger.
No revenue forecast is derived from this ledger.
No row may be back-filled from memory, from a search engine result, or from a third-party estimator.
Rows are never deleted. Corrections are appended as new rows referencing the row they correct.
Our own outbound_click counts and Amazon's reported clicks are different measurements and are never added together.
